name: steps-bar
title: Steps Bar
description: Steps towards a goal: the bar fills from olive to green as a small walker strides along its front.

perf.budget: The bar moves on a UI-thread spring on change. The walker is one view on a UI-thread loop until the goal, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The bar jumps to its place, the walker holds still and the count does not climb.
a11y.screenReader: One progress bar ("6,317 STEPS, 4.2 KM, 9 FLOORS").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { StepsBar } from '@/components/kinetik/steps-bar';

<StepsBar steps={6317} distance="4.2 KM" climb="9 FLOORS" />;
```

## When to use

- Daily step or distance goals.
- Any single count towards a target with a bit of character.

## When not to use

- Several goals at once. Use Activity Rings.
- Counts with no target.

## Notes

- The walker stops once the goal is reached.
- The scale marks 0, half and the goal.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add steps-bar`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
